activityDesc.low: Daily life plus some light walking or exercise (most Korean adults)
activityDesc.active: Quite a lot of walking or exercise each day
activityDesc.veryActive: Long hours of hard training or physical work

foodStyle.screenDesc: Saves how you choose food. It is separate from your nutrition targets and is not used for food suggestions or ingredient checks yet.
foodStyle.title: Food style

desc.vegetarian: No meat or fish. Set eggs and dairy below
desc.mediterranean: Vegetables, beans, whole grains, fish, olive oil
desc.carnivore: Mostly animal foods. Macros follow your nutrition target mode

foodStyle.allergyNote: Saved separately from food style. For your records only; photos are not checked for allergens.

nutrition.title: Nutrition targets
nutrition.step2Desc: Describe your day, then pick your activity level yourself.
nutrition.step4Desc: Check the maintenance estimate and the target, then apply. Your current target stays until you apply.
nutrition.bodyNote: Leave sex or age empty and only custom targets are available.
nutrition.scopeTitle: Who the auto calculation is for
nutrition.scopeNote: The automatic calculation is for adults 19 and over. If any of these apply, or you are under 19, the general adult calculation is not used and only custom targets open. Set targets with your care team.

special.medicalDiet: On a diet for treating a condition

nutrition.levelNote: Use the above as a guide and pick for your whole day including exercise. There is no validated rule that sets the level from workout counts, so the app does not pick it for you. Because your exercise is in this level, its calories are not added to your meal target again.
nutrition.modeBlocked: The automatic calculation does not apply, so only custom targets are available.

modeDesc.balanced: Split by share of calories. Starts at carbs 55 · protein 20 · fat 25%
modeDesc.training: Set protein by body weight (g/kg) first, then split the rest
modeDesc.custom: Set the ratio or grams yourself

nutrition.adjustNote: The app's starting value for {{goal}} is {{start}}. It is an app policy, not an official recommendation, and you can change it.
nutrition.balancedNote: A starting point picked by the app, not the one official ratio.
nutrition.trainingNote: Starting values are app choices (lose 2.0 · keep 1.6 · lean bulk/bulk 1.8 g/kg, fat 25%). For reference, ISSN (2017) gives 1.4–2.0 g/kg/day for most exercising people. Carbs fill the remaining calories.

customDesc.ratio: Set calories and the carb/protein/fat share (total 100%). Shares are of calories, not weight.
customDesc.fixKcal: Set calories and two nutrients; the third is calculated.
customDesc.grams: Set carb/protein/fat grams; total calories are calculated.

nutrition.advancedNote: Diets that limit carbs. Set a carb target; protein follows the mode and the remaining calories go to fat. Starting values are app choices, not universal standards.

carbDesc.lowCarb: Starts at 40% carbs. For reference, ADA (2019) describes low carb as 26–45% of calories
carbDesc.lchf: Starts at 20% carbs. Fewer carbs, more fat
carbDesc.keto: Set in grams of total carbs only. Starts at 50 g

nutrition.ketoNote: Logged carbs are total carbs estimated from photos. There is no fiber data, so net carbs are not calculated, and logs cannot tell whether you are in ketosis.
nutrition.noExerciseAdd: Maintenance uses the 2025 Korean DRI adult energy requirement equation. Your usual exercise is in the activity level you picked, so its calories are not added again.
nutrition.customKcalNote: Calories you set yourself, separate from the maintenance estimate.
nutrition.macroNote: Split by share of calories. Grams are rounded to whole numbers when applied.
nutrition.amdrRange: The 2025 Korean DRI acceptable range for adults is carbs {{c}}%, protein {{p}}%, fat {{f}}%. It is a general adult reference and training targets can differ.
nutrition.amdrOutside: {{names}} is outside this reference range. You can still save it.

block.missingSex: Sex is not set, so maintenance can't be estimated. Use custom or set sex in step 1.
block.missingAge: Age is not set, so maintenance can't be estimated.
block.missingActivity: Activity level is not picked, so maintenance can't be estimated.
block.minor: The adult calculation is not used under 19. Only custom targets are available.
block.special: The general adult calculation is not used during pregnancy, breastfeeding or a treatment diet. Only custom targets are available.

err.ratioSum: Make the ratio add up to 100%.
err.negative: Not enough calories left, so {{macro}} goes below zero. Change the targets or calories.
err.belowMinAuto: The automatic result is below {{min}} kcal, so it is not recommended. Lower the adjustment. Targets outside this app's range ({{min}} kcal and up) should be set with a professional.
err.belowMinCustom: Custom targets in this app start at {{min}} kcal. If you need a lower target, set it with a professional. Logging meals works regardless of the target.
err.carbOverKcal: The carb target is larger than total calories.
err.invalid: Some fields are empty or not numbers.

onboarding.permCameraDesc: We'll ask when you take a meal photo

gym.useCurrentHere: At the gym? Use where you are
gym.privacySearch: Your search and rough location go through our server to Kakao only while searching. The gym you pick is saved on your phone and in your settings backup.

settings.localBuildNote: This test build stores records on your device. AI analysis, backup and sharing with friends require a server and are unavailable in this build.
settings.title: Settings
settings.modeNormalDesc: Miss a deadline and apps lock for 2 hours
settings.modeSpicyDesc: Protein goal, cheat coupons, random photo checks
settings.lockSoon: Lock settings open with the lock feature
settings.photoAnalysisNote: Photos are stored on this phone. They are only sent to the server, shrunk to 1024px on the long side, to recognize food, and the server doesn't keep them.
settings.photoBackupDesc: When on, meal photos are stored on the server (Cloudflare R2) so a new phone can restore them. Turning it off deletes every uploaded photo; they stay only on this phone.
settings.targetsDesc: Going over never locks your phone. This is just a reference.
settings.logoutBody: Your records stay on this phone. Sign in again to keep using them.
settings.deleteBody: Your account and all records backed up on the server will be deleted. This cannot be undone. Records on this phone will be erased too.
settings.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete your account. Check your connection and try again.
settings.shareFriendsDesc: You can change it per meal when logging
settings.notificationsDesc: Before and at meal deadlines, and at gym time
settings.notifDeniedBody: Allow FitDoing notifications in your phone settings to get deadline reminders.

lockSetup.title: Lock settings and permissions
lockSetup.disclosure: Restrict other apps at meal deadlines and workout or sleep times. Usage access identifies the app in use; display over other apps shows the lock screen. This is processed on your device. App blocking requires these permissions. An ongoing notification appears while locking is active.
lockSetup.usageAccessDesc: Identify the app currently in use.
lockSetup.overlayDesc: Show the lock screen over a restricted app.
lockSetup.exactAlarmDesc: Start locking on schedule even when the app is closed.
lockSetup.notificationsDesc: Show locking status and deadline reminders.
lockSetup.unavailable: Native app locking is unavailable in this build.
lockSetup.openFailed: Could not open settings. Check FitDoing permissions in Android Settings.
lockSetup.alwaysAllowed: Phone, messages, maps, alarms, keyboard and FitDoing stay available. Select any additional apps to allow below.
